Bayang-bayang Atas Batavia

 

Introduction

This campaign is set in Batavia during 1910. This period of time is still heavily favoring people of the Dutch and Indo-Belanda ancestry, but due to Queen Wilhelmina, the recently crowned queen, and her Ethische Politiek (Ethical Policy), the Inlanders (indigenous population) of Dutch East Indies are given limited opportunity of education and emigration to even the Netherlands, the Dutch homeland.

This campaign will deal with a series of strange occurrences in Batavia, caused by the forces of the Red Death in the city. This will range from strange and cruel murders, monster sightings, occultic rumors, and others. This campaign will also deal with slice of life portions roleplaying in Batavia, amidst the rising national determinism and anti-racism of the colonizers.

Materials

We will use "Masque of the Red Death and Other Tales" books as the main material. This is a campaign setting, under the Ravenloft title, that set in Gothic Earth of 1890s. The book thus uses Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd Edition rules, an old edition of the D&D rule sets. To give further context to the AD&D 2e rules, I will also provide the PHB of the said edition. Do prepare for the occurrence of THAC0 (tako) and descending Armor Class, being infamous and confusing rules, but we will try to understand it together. This old edition also has some clunky dice mechanics, both roll under DC if doing ability checks and roll over DC if doing combat rolls.

How to Apply?

To play in this campaign, please fill in the application form here. This is not first come first serve, so I will audit the pool and select the ones that I think fit me. I will contact you through Discord message if you're accepted.

Please fill the form with passion and show your personality! Please don't use AI to generate answers for you because then I'll hate you so much. This campaign will be an exercise of collaborative storytelling, so I don't want to choose to play with promptists and scrapists that delegate their mind and thinking, what made them “human”, to soulless language models (I am a spiritualist so don't say that I don't believe in souls).

"Why do you want to play old edition?"

Because I like old books and materials. The D&D and TRPG hobby have a long history of material publication and this book fascinated me for a long time. I don't want to forget and ignore the history and the treasure trove of old editions offerings. Also, the old books are free from AI slop that inundated nowadays landscape of play. The old books are also charming in their own ways.

 

Consideration for Character Concept

Select your place in the racial hierarchy of Dutch East Indies. You can select from four flavors of segregation:

  • •.Europeans (primarily the pure Dutch, without mixed blood). The ruler of the people beneath them, the colonizers. Some of them are sympathetic to the Inlanders' plights, be it from integrity or grinding capitalistic mindset. 

  • •.Indo-Belanda (or Indo-European, Sinyo, and other terms). Children from European and Inlander ancestry. Legally they are classified as Europeans, but of course due to racism they are discriminated against based on how white their skin color is. Can be elitist of their Dutch blood, lost in both of two worlds and not belong to anything, and full on segregated. 

  • •.Foreign Orientals (Chinese, Indian, Arab, etc.). They are considered as second class citizen and face discrimination from the Europeans too. The hierarchical system makes them harder to attend education and participate in many social circles. 

  • •.Inlanders (indigenous populations, natives). The majority population of Dutch East Indies, but the one with the lowest rights and social status. Places are constantly segregated from the natives, equaling dogs with Inlanders. The recent Ethische Politiek from Queen Wilhelmina gives some welfare to the Inlanders but things are still suck for them. 

Do remember: this campaign is not the place for the players and player characters to be racist and involve themselves in such system!! This campaign is a place for us to resist and be woke against racism and systems of oppression. The included system serves to be fought and not to be supported.

Qabal

The PCs party in a “Masque of the Red Death” campaign is called a qabal. It's connotation of occultism as well as of magickal properties. A qabal in this campaign is of protective order of witches and knights fighting against the forces of the Red Death. The qabals of the campaign are opposing the Red Death's intent on leading our world to a terrible future. The qabal of our group is a coterie of quite modern witches and knights of early twentieth century (1910) era.

 

PC Options

As opposed to standard AD&D 2e races and classes, in a “Masque of the Red Death” campaign there is only the human race and Gothic Earth era appropriate equivalent of the core D&D classes translated to fit the time period. Such classes are:

  • •Soldier: equivalent to Warrior/Fighter 

  • •Tradesman: Rogue 

  • •Adept: Wizard 

  • •Mystic: Priest 

There are also proficiencies system, like proto-background. In here, each class selects some amounts of proficiencies, either from weapon or non-weapon types to further customize the character better to fit the players' wishes. More or less these proficiencies also function like skills in a skill-based system like Call of Cthulhu.
